screens.screen: home — dashboard (8 stat cards + section tiles)

notes: Read from the local read-only checkout /Users/ar/MyDocuments/projects/maskani/maskani_admin (v1.0.44+45). The code itself says the home has no side menu or drawer (sections open as full pages), and it is a phone app, so phone format. Light theme only, IBM Plex Sans Arabic from the repo, primary #171539; icons are the real Solar glyphs from the local solar_community_icons font. Logo: no screen in lib/ loads an image asset (assets/icons/app_icon*.png are launcher icons only); the home header is drawn by code as a navy rounded box with a Solar 'home' glyph next to 'لوحة إدارة مسكني', so that is what is shown and the brand logo file is not used. Sample data: counters, listing titles, prices, cities, user names, phone numbers (patterned, fictional) and ids. Prices are printed as the code prints them: raw API decimal string + currency code (e.g. '180000.00 YER'), no thousands separator. Property photos are network images in the app; here they are soft gradient thumbnails, and one row uses the code's own no-image fallback (grey box + building icon). User avatars use the code's no-photo fallback. In the users list the search hint and magnifier are very faint because the code colours them with the 'stroke' token, which maps to the divider colour (#E7E7F0) in this app; drawn as coded. The analytics screen (fl_chart) was not chosen: inside SectionPage its KPI cards are sized from the full screen width and would wrap two per row, so it would not look tidy.
